summary: SOBR Safe filed an 8-K reporting board-approved retention bonuses for three directors and named executive officers to induce them to remain through the 2026 annual meeting. Payments total $175,000 for directors, split 60% within ten days of September 22, 2026 and 40% due November 30, 2026 contingent on the meeting occurring and execution of a release. The filing also covers related Section 5.02 compensatory arrangements and an Item 8.01 annual-meeting item. No equity stake, price per share, premium, advisor, or deal clock is stated; the retention context implies board continuity concerns.
